QuestInfo.name: [Slime] Bobbly Bit
QuestInfo.0: The first thing you thought of was to just hunt Slimes. Talk to #b#p9000292##k.
QuestInfo.1: You decided to bring back  #b100#k #bSlime Bits#k.
QuestInfo.2: You gave the Slime Bits to #b#p9000292##k. What do they taste like?

0.0: None of it is really that complicated. This isn't a field of reasoning or wits, but a forbidden one of daring and bravery.
0.1: Slimes seem to disappear when they get eliminated, but they actually reform after a few minutes. It has been established that they are not edible for that very reason.
0.2: What part of them would you eat? They don't have hands or feet, just their body... But have you noticed their antenna? They tend to come off when you hunt Slimes, right?
0.3: So I'd like you to hunt Slimes and get me 100 Slime Bits. Then I can begin my research on them...\r\n#r<< You will be moved to a battle map when you accept. >>

yes.0: Good, I'll send you to where the Slimes are.

no.0: Boo, I was looking forward to discovering a new taste!

1.0: Did you get enough Slime Bits?

yes.0: Let me see. Ooooh, it's looks chewy! It's also slimy, so how to eat it is the question. I don't think this would be safe to consume raw...

default.0: You haven't gathered enough Slime Bits. If you want to go back to where the Slimes are, #rforfeit the quest#k and talk to me again.
